entry.summary: What are the similarities, differences, benefits and use cases of ELT and ETL. ELT (extract, load, transform) and ETL (extract, transform, load) are both data integration processes that move raw data from a source system to a target database. These data sources can be in multiple, different repositories or in legacy systems that are then transferred using ELT or ETL to a target data location. Both approaches move data from source to destination but where transformation happens changes everything about cost, speed, flexibility, and the kind of analytics you can build.
